tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Off-white like photocopier paper in Paper; near-black like a sound-system dance in Night. Also the light squares of the checkerboard.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and hard 2px borders on `paper` (16:1 in both themes). Also the dark squares of the checkerboard.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper`: captions, dates, venue details (6.4:1 Paper, 7.9:1 Night).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: A panel that stays dark in both themes, like a sound-system dance: page headers, the footer, photo backdrops. In Night it sits a shade darker than `paper` and is set off by a `border-hard` `ink` edge or a checkerboard.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text, links and focus rings on `night` panels (16:1 Paper, 17:1 Night).

tokens.name: scarlet
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Big fills: hero blocks, primary buttons, the nav bar, gig date stamps. As text only at 24px and over (4.7:1 on `paper` in Paper, 3.5:1 in Night).

tokens.name: scarlet-ink
tokens.usage: Scarlet for small text: links and inline emphasis on `paper` (6.5:1 Paper, 6.8:1 Night).

tokens.name: on-scarlet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `scarlet` fills (5.1:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Accent fill from the Jamaican flag: stickers, 'new' and 'tonight' badges, highlighter strips behind a word. Never text on `paper` in Paper (1.6:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on `gold` fills (10.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Secondary accent from the Jamaican flag, used sparingly: a strip in a tricolour band, a 'tickets on sale' tag. Never the main colour of a page.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on `green` fills (6.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 3px outline offset 3px. Ink in Paper (16:1 on `paper`, 4:1 on `scarlet`), gold in Night (10.3:1 on `paper`).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The band name and one hero line per page. Always uppercase.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page titles and gig headlines. Uppercase.

styles.name: tape
styles.usage: Cut-out labels: one to three words, uppercase, on an `ink` or `scarlet` strip with `space-1` by `space-2` padding, tilted by a `tilt` token. Kickers, 'sold out', 'new single'.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ska from Bristol. Skank first, ask questions later.
styles.usage: Bio copy and all running text.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Typewritten labels: dates, kickers, photo credits. The zine voice; never more than a line.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps between a label and its value; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside buttons and between inline items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between paragraphs, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; the checkerboard square size.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default. Buttons, cards, photos and blocks are square cut.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form inputs only, to soften browser defaults.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Round stickers and badges, like a badge pinned to a jacket.

tokens.name: border-hard
tokens.usage: Every border is solid `ink` at this width: cards, inputs, buttons, photos on `paper`.

tokens.name: shadow-offset
tokens.usage: Hard, unblurred offset shadow for cards, buttons and photos, like a misregistered print. No soft shadows anywhere.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons: the element moves 4px down and right and its shadow shrinks to this.

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: `tape` labels only, alternating with `tilt-right`. Blocks, photos and text stay upright.

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: The partner to `tilt-left`, for `tape` labels only.

tokens.name: tilt-sticker
tokens.usage: Round `radius-pill` stickers only, which carry one or two words.

tokens.name: halftone
tokens.usage: Opacity of the `ink` halftone dot texture over `scarlet` blocks and photo edges. Never over text.
